reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a loan of up to EUR 40 million for the development, construction, and operation of solar PV plants in Romania with aggregate capacity of 189.7MWp (the "Project"), including the Sadova solar power plant of 61.9MWp located in Dolj County and the Dobrun solar power plants of 127.8 MWp located in Olt County The Project will contribute to climate change mitigation and the Romanian green energy transition by increasing the share of renewable energy generation in the country and adding new solar generation capacity to the national energy system. In addition, the Project will also strengthen private sector presence in the renewable energy sector in the country.
